question_relevant.description: How well the question targets a concrete fact, event, definition or relation from the article, 1 (off-topic or trivial) to 5 (a substantive fact the article really covers).

question_self_contained.description: How well the question stands on its own, 1 (only makes sense next to the article) to 5 (fully understandable to a reader who never saw the article).

answer_correct.description: How factually correct the answer is according to the article, 1 (contradicts the article) to 5 (entirely correct).

answer_grounded.description: How well every claim in the answer is supported by the article, 1 (contains fabricated or contradicting claims) to 5 (every claim explicitly supported, no outside knowledge).

fluency.description: How fluent, natural and grammatical the Dutch of the question and answer is, 1 (stilted or full of errors) to 5 (reads as written by a native speaker).

coherence.description: How well the answer logically addresses the question, 1 (does not answer it) to 5 (answers it precisely and completely).
